    Greek · Sides

    Yoghurt Sauce

    Our simple, tangy yoghurt sauce: just yoghurt, lemon, salt and pepper, mixed to taste.

    Serves
    4
    Prep5 min
    VegetarianUnder 30 min

    Ingredients

    Amounts with a number are scaled and rounded. Amounts in the method, and things like "to taste" or "a handful", stay as written.

    • 250 g (1 cup) Greek yoghurt
    • 15–30 ml (1–2 tbsp) lemon juice (about ½ lemon)
    • ¼ tsp salt
    • A few grinds of black pepper

    Tick things off as you go. Tap an ingredient's name to see where it's used.

    Method

    1. Mix the yoghurt, lemon juice, salt and pepper together.
    2. Taste and adjust: more lemon for tang, more salt to make it pop.
